# Nexora Technologies - Weekly Timesheet Submission & Client Billing Protocol

## 1. Overview and Purpose
This document establishes the official weekly timesheet submission, client billing attribution, and approval procedures for all full-time employees, contractors, and consultants at Nexora Technologies. Strict adherence ensures accurate client invoicing and timely payroll processing.

## 2. Submission Deadline & Cadence
- **Weekly Cutoff:** Every employee must submit their weekly timesheet no later than **Friday at 5:00 PM IST** (17:00 IST).
- **Grace Period:** A strict 2-hour automated grace period extends until 7:00 PM IST for exceptional client deliverables.
- **Submission Portal:** Submissions must be executed exclusively through the Nexora HRMS Portal at `https://hrms.nexoratech.internal/timesheets`. Submissions via email, Slack, or verbal agreement are strictly invalid.

## 3. Working Hours & Billing Codes
- **Standard Work Week:** Standard full-time expectation is **40 hours per week** (8 hours per working day, Monday through Friday).
- **Client Billing Code Structure:** All project time allocations must use the standardized format `NEX-[CLIENT]-[PROJECT_CODE]` (for example, `NEX-GLOBAL-104` or `NEX-TITAN-001`).
- **Internal Overhead Code:** Non-billable internal training or organizational meetings must be logged under code `NEX-CORP-INTERNAL-99`.
- **Overtime Authorization:** Any billable work exceeding 45 hours in a single week requires prior written sign-off from Delivery Head Marcus Vance.

## 4. Manager Approval & Verification Workflow
- Line managers and project leads must review and approve or reject all submitted team timesheets by **Monday at 12:00 PM IST**.
- Discrepancies between git commit activity, client ticketing systems (Jira), and logged hours will trigger an automated audit flag.

## 5. Non-Compliance and Late Submission Penalties
- **First Offense:** Automated warning email delivered to the employee and copied to their direct manager.
- **Second Offense:** Formal escalation to HR Head Roy Sterling.
- **Salary Hold Protocol:** Timesheets unapproved past Tuesday 5:00 PM IST will result in the immediate postponement of the month's variable performance pay until the subsequent payroll cycle.
